en-us.Greenside_Library_initial: An occasional turning page breaks the quiet of the study room. There is space on the desks for books and notes.
en-us.Greenside_Library_join: $joining.name$ eases out a chair in the study room and sets some books on the desk.
en-us.Greenside_Library_late: $joining.name$ opens the study room door a little late, steps lightly and takes an empty seat.
en-us.Greenside_Library_shared_initial: $attendees.name$ spread out their reading. At a pause between pages, someone quietly asks about a mark in the notes; another points out the relevant passage and borrows a sticky note to record the page number. A murmured thanks gives way to quiet again.
en-us.Greenside_Library_shared_arrival: $joining.name$ waits until $companions.name$ set down their pens, then quietly asks about a detail in the material at hand. They lay the relevant pages together, compare a few lines of the text and note the page numbers before returning the desk to their books.
en-us.Greenside_Library_finish: A page turns softly, and the study room settles back into quiet.
